title: Admin lists and audit views lack cursor pagination, filters and consistent totals

original_titles.title: Lists lack totals and cursor pagination; Load more refetches with a bigger limit and views silently truncate
Cursor-based pagination absent (no cursor, no meta.next_cursor, no HMAC-signed cursors)
Role management missing; audit viewer search incomplete (RM-01a, AU-01a S2)
Request IDs are plain text, not clickable/copyable and do not search the audit log
Repository search is bounded and rate-limited but not paginated

problem: Several list endpoints use fixed LIMIT caps (for example participant roster limit 500, review queue 200, announcements 100, audit max 500) without next_cursor/total metadata. Some UI “load more” patterns refetch a larger limit or cannot access older rows. Audit filtering is limited to action and limit.
impact: Larger events silently hide records beyond the cap; investigators cannot reliably trace older reviews, disputes, participants or audit events.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Define a consistent cursor format (created_at + unique id or seq) with opaque HMAC-signed cursor tokens. Include page_size, next_cursor and optional total_count.
Add stable ordering by (timestamp, id) and indexes that support cursor predicates. Reject negative or oversized page sizes.
Add server-side filters for event, team, email, status, date range, actor, action, submission id and review state as appropriate.
Update UI tables to load the next page instead of increasing LIMIT. Show exact count only when the count query is acceptable.
Test duplicate timestamps, inserts during pagination, cursor tampering, filter composition and records beyond the previous hard cap.

acceptance_criteria: No endpoint silently truncates a user-visible list without an explicit continuation token.
Cursor replay is stable and tampering is rejected.
Audit can filter by actor/action/time/entity and export bounded results.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
